title: Esophageal Impedance and Manometry Measurements and Dysphagia Symptom Scoring
official: Esophageal Impedance and Manometry Measurements and Dysphagia Symptom Scoring
summary: Comparison of manometry measurements and EndoFlip Balloon measurements in patients with dysphagia and a known esophageal diagnosis
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All patients who presented to GI Motility Lab at IU University Hospital for esophageal manometry-impedance and/or EndoFLIP

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age \<18 yrs old
* Unable to communicate verbally with the staff
